description:
Facepunch's Rust updates and devblogs. Every post from rust.facepunch.com/news, newest first. Each carries `slug`, `title`, `summary`,
`category` (`devblog`, `news`, `update`, ...), `published_date` (UTC date), `thumbnail_url`, `url` (the
official post, or this network's own write-up when `has_blog_post` is true) and `has_blog_post`. Polled every
few minutes; the first page is refreshed the moment a new post is found.
name: get_rust_updates
title: Facepunch's Rust updates and devblogs
